emily-partnerships: Heads-up — CloudBox says they're moving to metering schema v2 on 2024-10-15 (prod flip). Their marketplace contract requires 30d notice; they emailed today. We have ~3 weeks. Need quick plan: ingestion compatibility, entitlements mapping, and partner comms. They attached sample payload (asking for confirmation).
raj-engineering: Thanks. What are the main schema diffs? can we forward a sample? :eyes:
emily-partnerships: Quick diffs I got from their note:
- `resource_units` -> `units` (int)
- timestamps: epoch -> ISO8601 string (UTC)
- event dedupe key now `event_id` (was generated server-side)
- new `metering_version` top-level tag
They sent a sample JSON inline.
emily-partnerships: ```{
  "metering_version": "2",
  "event_id": "cbx-evt-12345",
  "timestamp": "2024-10-15T12:34:56Z",
  "units": 120,
  "resource_id": "rbx-67890",
  "plan": "pro-monthly"
}```
raj-engineering: Ok looks straightforward. Biggest risk is iso timestamps parsing + dedupe behavior change. We currently dedupe on (partner_id, epoch_ts, resource_units) hashed. We'll need to switch to (partner_id, event_id) when present and keep old logic for v1.
leo-infra: We can add a compatibility layer in ingestion-v2 that auto-detects `metering_version` or presence of `event_id`. Plan: accept both, normalize to internal schema, write canonical event with `canonical_event_id`. Low risk. I can scope a small feature flag + migration.
marta-legal: Before we start dev work, confirm their notice meets SOW amendment rules. Ask them to send a signed addendum confirming the date and that they'll continue to support v1 for 60 days post-flip. We can't be on the hook for breaking changes without a signed amendment.
olivia-ops: Can we request a shadow feed to validate transformation? If partner can stream a day or two of v2 to a staging webhook, we can run reconciliation tests. Also want replay window details — do they keep raw events for 30d?
emily-partnerships: I asked for sample feed and replay/retention SLAs. Also requested signed addendum and their rollback plan. They replied they can provide a 7-day shadow and will keep 90d raw logs.
raj-engineering: For reconciliation, mapping entitlements: any change to `plan` values? if yes we need mapping table. Also confirm billing unit semantics (is `units` per-second, per-minute, per-request?).
emily-partnerships: CloudBox says `units` equals token-units (same semantic as old) but they renamed for clarity. Plan strings are identical.
leo-infra: Timeline estimate: 2 dev days for compatibility shim + 1 day for tests + 1 day infra flag rollout and canary. We can target staging canary in ~10 business days.
marta-legal: I'll review the addendum once they send and confirm 60d v1 support. If they won't sign, we pause ingestion changes and request extended timeline.
olivia-ops: Ops action: set up reconciliation job to run in shadow mode daily for the 7-day window. Need partner sample URL + auth creds.
emily-partnerships: Action items:
- emily: get signed addendum + shadow feed (today/tomorrow)
- raj: draft compatibility shim PR (assigning to raj)
- leo: flag + canary pipeline + staging endpoint
- olivia: reconciliation job skeleton + alert thresholds
- marta: review & approve addendum
Please ack if you got this.
raj-engineering: ack. starting PR branch now. :rocket:
leo-infra: ack, will open infra task and schedule rollout after PR.
marta-legal: ack, available to review once they send doc.
olivia-ops: ack, will provision staging bucket/webhook and share creds.
deploy-bot: ingestion-service: deploy to staging scheduled for 1723459999 (canary window only). :robot_face:
emily-partnerships: Great — I'll follow up with partner and post updates here. :thumbsup:
